title: Fee Base Used for Parking License Early Cancellation Fees
content:
Resident accounting standard, Parking License: the fee base on which an early cancellation fee is measured follows what the license has actually been billing in the 3 months before the notice date.

## Standard

When the product carries a dedicated charger and energy was billed on the license in the 3 months before the notice date, the fee base is the average monthly net billing of that window: the monthly license fee lines, energy lines and idle fee lines posted on the license in the window, less the charge reversal and bundle discount credits posted on the license in the window, divided by 3; when the product carries no dedicated charger and a bundle discount credit was posted on the license in that window, the fee base is the monthly license fee lines posted in the window less the bundle discount credits posted in the window, divided by the number of monthly license fee lines posted in the window; in every other case the fee base is the monthly fee in force on the license.

The product that carries a dedicated charger is the EV Charging Reserved Space. "Energy was billed" means at least one EV charging energy line was posted on the license in the window.

## Which method applies

| Dedicated charger | In the 3 months before the notice date | Fee base |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least one energy line | the window's monthly fee, energy and idle fee lines, less its charge reversal and bundle discount credits, divided by 3 |
| yes | no energy line | the monthly fee in force on the license |
| no | at least one bundle discount credit | the window's monthly fee lines less its bundle discount credits, divided by the number of monthly fee lines in the window |
| no | no bundle discount credit | the monthly fee in force on the license |

## Worked examples (hypothetical ledgers)

**EV Charging Reserved Space.** In the window: three monthly fee lines of $125.00 ($375.00), energy lines totalling $42.60, idle fee lines totalling $36.00, one charge reversal credit of $12.00 and three bundle discount credits of $12.50 ($37.50). Net billing: $375.00 plus $42.60 plus $36.00, less $12.00 and less $37.50, is $404.10; divided by 3, the fee base is $134.70.

**Covered Carport Space.** In the window: two monthly fee lines of $65.00 ($130.00) and two bundle discount credits of $6.50 ($13.00). The fee base is $130.00 less $13.00, that is $117.00, divided by the 2 fee lines: $58.50.

A charge reversal credit counts in the window by the date it was posted on the license.
